document.abstract: (1.1) This guideline specifies the allocation of input audio signals to digital audio channels on digital television tape recorders (DTTRs) when the inputs are connected through AES/EBU digital interfaces. (1.2) This guideline also specifies preferred assignments of programs to audio recording channels, on the basis of program type, for purposes of program exchange.
